todos.text: Open a separate PR against main to make ProbeAttacher.Attach receive the matched *process.RawMapping, add forwarding tests, ask Florian to review, then rebase PR1 and attach uprobes to the actual mapped file.

Fix and generalise heap probe payload handling: retain allocation size in the live userspace tracker so inuse_objects uses weighted_bytes / size (currently it counts sampled live allocations), and revisit the generic Trace value/ptr/size origin-specific side channel, including parsing USDT argument-location descriptors instead of assuming fixed ABI registers.
